title: Clapping from excitement is a 15-month social item
summary: Most children clap when they are excited by about 15 months, CDC says.
body: CDC lists clapping when excited among 15-month social milestones. The clap here is tied to excitement, not to the partner song named on the first-birthday list. Most means 75 percent or more, so a child who claps later is not outside every possible path. The page says these materials are not a substitute for a validated developmental screen. The age comes from the US checklist.
